description: Named variables of the Incubus's behaviour (chara/Incubus/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: incubus_timer
fields.note: The countdown of the current attack step (Q12 seconds).

fields.name: incubus_flags
fields.note: Bit 2: the boss is armed (its effects are drawn while it fights).

fields.name: incubus_defeats
fields.note: Counts the defeats; damage is taken only while it is 0.

fields.name: incubus_fight_timer
fields.note: Runs down while Harry has no usable long gun ammo; below 0 the boss falls.
